---
title: "Baby Names Analysis: Greta"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

baby_names <- read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

events <- tibble(
  year = c(1918, 1929, 1945, 1969, 2001, 2020),
  event = c(
    "WWI Ends (1918)",
    "Great Depression (1929)",
    "WWII Ends (1945)",
    "Moon Landing (1969)",
    "9/11 Attacks (2001)",
    "COVID-19 (2020)"
  ),
  y_pos = c(510, 450, 510, 560, 510, 440)
)

baby_names |>
  filter(str_to_upper(name) == "GRETA") |>
  summarize(count = sum(count), .by = year) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count)) +
  geom_vline(
    data = events,
    aes(xintercept = year),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray55"
  ) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(
    data = events,
    aes(x = year, y = y_pos, label = event),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 3,
    color = "gray30"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.18))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 600)) +
  labs(
    title = "Popularity of the Name 'Greta' Over Time",
    subtitle = "U.S. Social Security Administration baby name registrations (1880–2025) with key U.S. historical events",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    caption = "Source: Social Security Administration (ssa.gov)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
